Capture pages

One employee per batch. Scan, photograph or type — every page lands in the review queue with its volume and page reference.

Mixed reading is slower. Handwriting is not reliably read — expect manual entry or rescanning.
Pages are numberedin the order the files are listed, starting from the SR page above. A multipage PDF adds one SR page per PDF page.

Reading the page…
The screen can pause for a few seconds while the text is read.

The order or proceedings copy is filed against this entry only — each column keeps its own orders, and each one can be saved as its own PDF. A multi-page PDF is split into sheets automatically.

Auto-correct fixes common reading mistakes in English labels, numbers and dates. It never invents values — check every field against the page.

Processing & AI

What reads your pages, where records are kept, and what still needs department integration.

Loads the engine and the chosen language, reads the sample page and reports time and mean word confidence. The engine and language data load from the internet the first time.

On-device assist

no internet

Learns from the register you have already entered. Every value saved against a field becomes a known value for that field, so a misread of it is matched back — in Telugu as well as English, because it compares characters, not meaning. It offers; it never changes a field by itself.

Online AI assist

hosted only

Corrects harder readings — broken Telugu lines above all — through an online assist service. It asks before anything is sent, sends the page text only and never the image, and is told never to add a value that is not in the text.

Not available in the standalone file, which has no server behind it. Everything else in this application works there.

Every saved page can be issued as a PDF: the typed record, the approval trail, the scanned page and any order copies filed against it. Columns and whole registers are built the same way, in this browser — nothing is sent anywhere.

PDFs carry the same migration-draft notice as the rest of this practice build. Telugu lines are drawn as pictures so the script prints exactly as it is on screen.

Exports are migration drafts. They are not an approved APGENCO import format and not an authenticated digital Service Register.
